reason: A is the better, though incremental, proposal because its processing intervention, densification mechanism, temperature, and mechanical/oxidation outcomes are experimentally grounded, with liquid-metal corrosion providing the principal new test. B relies on unsupported and internally inconsistent assumptions about substitutional Si, an intergranular phase, and protection in liquid metal, while its cited evidence concerns a high-entropy-boride/SiC composite rather than Si-doped ZrB2.
